notes_for_editor: Construction (1945) and the 83-foot height agree across four sources. Removal versus destruction is the only disagreement. A 1961 Seattle Times reference and a museum post seen only in search results give a 96-foot height; the post was not fetched and is not used. Willhite's photo captions and its 'communication towers' line are undated, so the present-day description is as of an unknown date. No reusable photos with licence were found.
